text: The Government of Samara Oblast is a founder ('Учредитель') of HC Lada, per the club's official partners page, where the region's logo opens the 'Partners and sponsors of HC Lada 2026/2027' section; the region's name and coat of arms are worn across the front of the 2026-27 home jersey, and the club is funded from the regional budget.
short: Samara Oblast's government is a founder of HC Lada, funds it from the regional budget, and carries its brand on the shirt front.

source.name: HC Lada official site, club partners page ('Партнеры и спонсоры ХК «Лада» 2026/2027')
source.note: Translation: 'Founder of HC Lada'. The label appears under the Samara Oblast logo (linking to samregion.ru) in the 2026/2027 partners section. The 'САМАРСКАЯ ОБЛАСТЬ' mark with the regional coat of arms across the front hem of the 2026-27 home jersey is visible in the club's own match-gallery photos (e.g. Lada–Dinamo Minsk, 14.09.2026) and the KHL press-service 2026/27 kit render (sports.ru, 13.09.2026).

additionalSources.name: Vedomosti.Sport: Самарская область готова выделить «Ладе» 750 млн рублей
additionalSources.quote: клубу на предстоящий сезон выделят 750 млн руб. из регионального бюджета
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'the club will be allocated 750 million rubles from the regional budget for the upcoming season' (acting sports minister of Samara Oblast, February 2023).

additionalSources.name: Жигули 63 (zhiguli63.info): «Лада» из Тольятти остаётся в КХЛ — инвестор и область гарантируют финансирование
additionalSources.quote: дополнительную поддержку хоккеистам окажет и областной бюджет
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'the regional budget will also provide additional support to the players' — governor of Samara Oblast after meeting the club's investor, May 2026.
